title: Solar Power Design and Installation Basics
desc: Learn to size, design and plan a small solar system with correct safety, cost, layout and handover.
outcomes: Explain how panels, inverters and batteries work together.
Size a small system from a load list.
Produce a design pack and handover sheet.
task: Design a small rooftop solar system for a practice home or shop, with load list, size, layout, safety plan, cost, payback and handover sheet.
condition: A computer, a spreadsheet, a floor plan or satellite view, two peers and a licensed electrician mentor. Installation on live wiring is done only by licensed people.
standard: Load list and size are correct; roof and shade checks are done; protective devices and earthing are listed; cost and payback shown; a licensed person signs the design; peers rate Meets or better.
who: Trainee electricians, technicians, small shop owners, community energy workers.
evidence: load list, sizing sheet, layout drawing, safety plan, cost sheet, handover sheet
modules: Panels make direct current; the inverter converts it.
Parts: panels, mounting, inverter, wiring, breakers, meter, optional battery.
A grid-tied system sends extra power to the network.
List each appliance: watts, hours a day.
Cut waste first, with efficient lamps and fans.
A shop uses 12 kWh a day; efficient lights save 1.5 kWh.
Orientation, tilt, shade, roof strength, space.
Sun hours per day in your place.
Safe roof access and fall protection.
A shade from a tank costs 8% in the afternoon; panels are moved.
Do a mock survey from a photo.
Panel kW = daily kWh / (sun hours x system efficiency).
Choose inverter slightly below panel kW.
Battery size from backup hours and depth of discharge.
12 kWh a day, 5 sun hours, 0.75 efficiency: about 3.2 kW of panels.
Fuses, breakers, surge protection, isolators and earthing.
A DC isolator is added near the inverter.
Panels make power in daylight: treat as live.
A crew stops on a windy afternoon.
Panels, inverter, mounting, cable, labour, permits.
Savings per year from bills; maintenance.
Payback and lifetime cost per kWh.
Cost 210,000 INR; saving 32,000 INR a year; payback 6.6 years.
Teach the owner cleaning and safety.
The owner receives a one-page guide with shut-down steps.
Produce a design pack and handover sheet.
Pack signed by a licensed person.
rubric: Every claim linked to a dated record and checked by a peer
Checked, dated and explained to others
next: wind energy, electric car basics, energy efficiency.
local: Electrical and net-metering rules differ by place.
